title: The Key to the Universe (Forgotten Books Edition)
author: Harriette and F. Homer Curtiss
description: A Forgotten Books edition of the Curtisses' study of numerical symbolism and spiritual cosmology. It presents numbers as a language for interpreting universal order, linking symbolic meanings with personal and religious understanding.
editionNote: Curator-supplied PDF and EPUB from the organised ebook collection. One format was converted from the other (PDF from EPUB).
rights: From the curator's private collection. Publication rights for this edition are to be confirmed before public release.
